problem: Write the equation of the hyperbola $7{x}^{2}-2{y}^{2}=28$ in standard form.
worked_solution:
The Cartesian equation of a horizontal hyperbola centered at the origin is

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1.
$$

Therefore, to write the equation of the hyperbola in standard form, we need to divide both sides of the equation by $28$ and then simplify, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}7{x}^{2}-2{y}^{2} & =28 \\ \frac{7{x}^{2}}{28}-\frac{2{y}^{2}}{28} & =\frac{28}{28} \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{4}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{14} & =1\end{aligned}
$$
